items.readerTitle: Read the whole chart first

They combine distinct structural evidence instead of turning each planet into a separate paragraph.

items.readerTitle: Several chart functions form a high-tension network
items.text: Sun, Venus, Mars, and Jupiter form a closed high-tension network. The reading keeps the interaction among several chart functions visible without turning the geometry into a good/bad or destiny verdict.
items.readerSummary: Sun, Venus, Mars, and Jupiter form a closed high-tension network. The reading keeps the interaction among several chart functions visible without turning the geometry into a good/bad or destiny verdict.

items.readerTitle: A concentrated tension pattern becomes a key pressure point
items.text: Saturn, Uranus, and Pluto form a concentrated tension structure, with Saturn at the geometric focus. It shows where pressure converges in the network without predicting that a specific problem must occur.
items.readerSummary: Saturn, Uranus, and Pluto form a concentrated tension structure, with Saturn at the geometric focus. It shows where pressure converges in the network without predicting that a specific problem must occur.

items.readerTitle: Many chart pathways run through Mercury
items.text: As ruler of the Ascendant sign, Mercury becomes an important routing reference for the chart. The dispositor network also links through Saturn, Venus, Sun, Mars, and Moon; this describes structural routing rather than making any planet a total personality label or fate controller.

items.readerTitle: The aspect network carries different degrees of movement
items.text: At the birth moment, 5 aspect links are moving closer to exact, 13 are moving away, and 5 sit within the exact tolerance. This classifies the geometry at that moment; it is not an event forecast.

items.readerTitle: The chart distributes its emphasis across elements and modes
items.text: Fire and Water share the highest element count (3/10 each); Cardinal and Fixed share the highest mode count (4/10 each). These are distribution counts across the ten core planets, not direct personality rankings or fixed psychological labels.

items.readerTitle: 先看整张盘
items.text: 先看三条整盘主线：几股命盘功能形成一个高张力网络；一个支持性网络被一条对向轴线集中起来；命盘里的多条结构路线经过水星。这些主题来自不同结构证据的组合，而不是把每颗星体分别写成一段。

items.readerTitle: 几股命盘功能形成一个高张力网络
items.text: 太阳、金星、火星、木星形成一个闭合的高张力连接网络。这里强调的是几股命盘功能彼此牵动的结构，不把它转换成吉凶或命运结论。

items.readerTitle: 一个支持性网络被一条对向轴线集中起来
items.text: 太阳、月亮、水星、金星形成一个支持网络，并由一条对向轴线把结构集中起来。它描述几何如何汇聚，不把这种结构解释成必然机会或成就。

items.readerTitle: 命盘里的多条结构路线经过水星
items.text: 水星作为上升星座的守护星，成为整盘路由的重要参照。守护链还连接到土星、金星、太阳、火星、月亮；这里描述的是结构如何转接，不把任何一颗行星定义成完整人格或命运控制者。

items.readerTitle: 相位网络呈现不同程度的趋近与分离
items.text: 出生时刻的相位连接中，5 条正在趋近精确角度，13 条正在离开精确角度，5 条处于精确容差内。这是对当时几何状态的分类，不是事件预测。

items.readerTitle: 地平线入口与公共轴线共同框定命盘取向
items.text: 上升点落在双子座，天顶落在双鱼座。这组轴线用来组织命盘如何进入即时情境，以及公共方向如何变得可见；它不是固定人格或事业结果的事实判断。
